data.text: I’ll join John and Jack: 15 tons, with all $15,000 paid directly to the clinic today, provided Kate commits too and Luke catches zero. These are our neighbors, and I’m willing to give up this month’s income to help restore their treatment. I also commit to six tons next month, then ten once the lake returns to 100 tons. Let’s record everyone’s catches and donation receipts here so we can keep this exception accountable. Kate, are you willing to complete the agreement?
